question: Where is the headquarters of the North Atlantic Treaty Organisation (NATO) situated? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (08/04/2021) Shift 1)
options: Lisbon
Ottawa
Brussels
Madrid
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Brussels

Explanation:
The North Atlantic Treaty Organisation (NATO) is a military alliance established in 1949. Its headquarters is located in Brussels, the capital of Belgium. NATO's primary objective is to provide collective security and military cooperation among its member nations in the North Atlantic region. The alliance initially had 12 founding members, including the United States, the United Kingdom, France, and Canada. Currently, there are 31 member countries. Brussels is also known as the headquarters of the European Union (EU), but NATO's headquarters is separate.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ When was NATO founded? → 4 April 1949
☛ Where is NATO headquarters located? → Brussels, Belgium
☛ What is NATO's core principle? → Collective defense (Article 5)
☛ How many founding members did NATO have? → 12
☛ When did India become a NATO member? → India has never been a NATO member

question: In which of the following cities, United Nation's subsidiary regional headquarters is NOT opened? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (08/04/2021) Shift 1)
options: Vienna
Nairobi
Rome
Geneva
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Rome

Explanation:
The United Nations (UN) has several subsidiary regional headquarters across the world, but Rome does not host any such subsidiary regional headquarters. The major regional UN headquarters are located in Geneva (Switzerland), Vienna (Austria), and Nairobi (Kenya). Geneva hosts the European headquarters of UN and numerous agencies; Vienna houses the UN International Centre and the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA); Nairobi hosts the UN Office at Nairobi (UNON), which serves as the UN headquarters in Africa. While Rome is home to specialized UN agencies like FAO, WFP, and IFAD, these are independent agency headquarters and not subsidiary regional headquarters of the UN itself. Therefore, among the options, Rome is the city where a UN subsidiary regional headquarters is not opened.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Where is the UN European headquarters located? → Geneva
☛ Which UN body is associated with the Vienna office? → IAEA
☛ What is the full form of UNON? → United Nations Office at Nairobi
☛ Which UN agency has its headquarters in Rome? → FAO (Food and Agriculture Organization)
☛ How many major UN regional headquarters are there? → Four (New York, Geneva, Vienna, Nairobi)
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस शहर में संयुक्त राष्ट्र का सहायक क्षेत्रीय मुख्यालय नहीं है? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (08/04/2021) Shift 1)
options_hi: वियना
नैरोबी
रोम
जेनेवा
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है रोम

Explanation:
संयुक्त राष्ट्र (UN) के सहायक क्षेत्रीय मुख्यालय विभिन्न शहरों में स्थित हैं, लेकिन रोम में कोई UN सहायक क्षेत्रीय मुख्यालय नहीं है। UN के प्रमुख क्षेत्रीय मुख्यालय जेनेवा (स्विट्जरलैंड), वियना (ऑस्ट्रिया) और नैरोबी (केन्या) में हैं। जेनेवा में UN का यूरोपीय मुख्यालय और कई एजेंसियां हैं; वियना में UN का अंतर्राष्ट्रीय केंद्र और अंतर्राष्ट्रीय परमाणु ऊर्जा एजेंसी (IAEA) है; नैरोबी में UN का अफ्रीका के लिए मुख्यालय (UNON) है। रोम में UN के कुछ विशेष एजेंसियां जैसे FAO, WFP और IFAD के मुख्यालय हैं, लेकिन ये सहायक क्षेत्रीय मुख्यालय नहीं हैं, बल्कि विशेष एजेंसियों के स्वतंत्र मुख्यालय हैं। अतः रोम को छोड़कर अन्य तीनों शहरों में UN के सहायक क्षेत्रीय मुख्यालय मौजूद हैं।

question: What does WORM stand for? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (08/04/2021) Shift 1)
options: Write once, read many
World open, receive many
Write others, read me
Wireless once, receive many
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Write once, read many

Explanation:
WORM stands for Write Once Read Many. It is a data storage technology where data can be written only once but can be read multiple times. This technology is commonly used in applications that require data permanence and security, such as CD-R and DVD-R. WORM drives are used for archival storage where data cannot be modified or deleted. It is useful for storing audit trails and legal documents. Once data is written on WORM media, it can only be read, ensuring data integrity. The main advantage is that it prevents accidental or intentional alteration of data, making it reliable for long-term storage.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Full form of WORM → Write Once Read Many
☛ Use of WORM technology → Archival storage
☛ Examples of WORM media → CD-R, DVD-R
☛ Characteristic of WORM data → Written once, read many
☛ Advantage of WORM → Data security and integrity
question_hi: WORM का पूर्ण रूप क्या है? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (08/04/2021) Shift 1)
options_hi: एक बार लिखें, कई बार पढ़ें
विश्व खुला, कई प्राप्त करें
दूसरों को लिखें, मुझे पढ़ें
एक बार वायरलेस, कई प्राप्त करें
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है एक बार लिखें, कई बार पढ़ें

Explanation:
WORM का पूर्ण रूप Write Once Read Many है। यह एक प्रकार की डेटा स्टोरेज तकनीक है जिसमें डेटा को केवल एक बार लिखा जा सकता है, लेकिन कई बार पढ़ा जा सकता है। इसका उपयोग मुख्य रूप से उन अनुप्रयोगों में किया जाता है जहां डेटा की स्थायित्व और सुरक्षा महत्वपूर्ण होती है, जैसे कि CD-R और DVD-R। WORM ड्राइव्स का उपयोग आर्काइवल स्टोरेज के लिए किया जाता है, जहां डेटा को संशोधित या मिटाया नहीं जा सकता। यह तकनीक ऑडिट ट्रेल और कानूनी दस्तावेजों के भंडारण में उपयोगी है। WORM मीडिया पर डेटा लिखने के बाद उसे केवल पढ़ा जा सकता है, जिससे डेटा की अखंडता बनी रहती है।

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ WORM का पूर्ण रूप → Write Once Read Many
☛ WORM तकनीक का उपयोग → आर्काइवल स्टोरेज
☛ WORM मीडिया का उदाहरण → CD-R, DVD-R
☛ WORM डेटा की विशेषता → एक बार लिखा, कई बार पढ़ा
☛ WORM का लाभ → डेटा सुरक्षा और अखंडता

question: WTO sets the rules for: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (08/04/2021) Shift 1)
options: terrorism
environment
global trade
global tour & travel
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is global trade

Explanation:
The WTO (World Trade Organization) is an international organization that sets the rules for global trade. Its primary goal is to ensure that trade between nations flows smoothly, predictably, and freely. The WTO provides a framework for trade agreements, resolves trade disputes, and reviews trade policies. It was established in 1995 and is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland. WTO rules cover various aspects including tariffs, quotas, subsidies, and intellectual property rights.

question: Which indicator is used to estimate the number of people who died prematurely due to a particular disease, as well as some years spent in the condition of disability due to illness? (RPF Constable 2018 (15/02/2019))
options: Global Weight of Illness (GBD)
Global Health Indicator
Human Development Index
World Health Index
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Global Weight of Illness (GBD)

Explanation:
The Global Burden of Disease (GBD) is a comprehensive health indicator that measures both premature death (mortality) and years lived with disability (morbidity) due to a specific disease. It is expressed in terms of DALY (Disability-Adjusted Life Years), which sums the years of life lost (YLL) due to premature death and years lived with disability (YLD). The GBD study is supported by the World Health Organization (WHO) and the World Bank and is used to prioritize health policies globally. Other options like the Human Development Index do not capture disease-specific burden.
